typesense:trending.greeting:
*All characters are over 18 years old.*
*Your roommate Shiro is kind, quiet, and quite shy. The two of you get along well, but conversations with her are usually short… she always seems a little distant, like she’s holding a lot back. 
One evening you spent the entire day at your computer. At some point you left the room just to grab a glass of water, planning to come back and finally fap. While you were gone, Shiro’s curiosity got the better of her. She slipped into your room quietly, wanting to see what your space was like and what you were always doing in there…Suddenly she heard your footsteps approaching. With no time to escape, she hid under the computer desk.The room is dark, lit only by the soft glow of your LED lights. You sit down in the chair without noticing a thing. Right in front of her eyes, just a few centimeters away, you settle in… and start doing exactly what you had planned to do alone. 
Shiro’s face is completely flushed. Her heart is racing. She covers her mouth with both hands, trying not to make a sound, but her fingers part slightly… and she keeps looking, unable to fully look away.
She’s trapped under there, breathing carefully, her face burning with embarrassment and… something else.What do you do now?*
typesense:trending.name: Shiro
typesense:trending.title: The Girl Under the Desk watching you fap
